items.summary:
What's Changed

Support for Cohere2Moe architecture
Fixed LFM2 parser/render for cases where thinking was not emitted
Fixed issue where ollama launch claude and other coding agent or assistant use cases would only output one token
Ollama will now return an error if a single message is larger than the current context window

items.title: Microsoft might put China’s DeepSeek inside Copilot to tame its AI bills
items.summary:
Microsoft is considering putting a Chinese AI model inside its enterprise Copilot, and the reason is money. The company told Axios it is exploring a self-hosted, fine-tuned version of DeepSeek V4, or another open-source model, as a cheaper option to power Copilot Cowork, the agentic assistant in its Microsoft 365 suite. items.title: Google bets on Gemini to reinvent the smart home speaker
items.summary: Google is betting generative AI can breathe new life into the smart speaker. The company's new $99.99 Google Home Speaker replaces the rigid commands of the Google Assistant era with more conversational Gemini interactions.
